title: Home & Living
description: Covers rooms and furniture vocabulary, describing your home, household chores, and asking about accommodation. Suited for elementary learners who want to talk about where they live.

content.content: {"time":1700000501000,"blocks":[{"id":"aB1cD2eF3g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"A house or apartment has different rooms. Learn the names:"}},{"id":"hI4jK5lM6n","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["living room — гостиная","bedroom — спальня","kitchen — кухня","bathroom — ванная комната","toilet / WC — туалет","dining room — столовая","hallway / corridor — прихожая / коридор","study / home office — кабинет","balcony — балкон","basement — подвал","attic — чердак","garage — гараж"]}},{"id":"oP7qR8sT9u","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Note: In British English, 'bathroom' often includes the toilet. In American English, they may be separate rooms."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: The car is in the garage.

content.text: My flat has a living room, two bedrooms, a kitchen, and a bathroom.

lessons.title: What We Do in Each Room

content.content: {"time":1700000502000,"blocks":[{"id":"vW0xY1zA2b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Each room has a purpose. We use prepositions in and at with rooms:"}},{"id":"cD3eF4gH5i","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I watch TV in the living room.","She cooks in the kitchen.","He sleeps in the bedroom.","We eat in the dining room.","I work in the study.","She takes a shower in the bathroom."]}},{"id":"jK6lM7nO8p","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"You can also describe a room:"}},{"id":"qR9sT0uV1w","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["The living room is large and bright.","The bedroom is small but cosy.","The kitchen is modern."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I watch TV in the living room. She cooks in the kitchen. The bedroom is small but cosy.
I sleep [in] the bedroom. We cook [in] the kitchen. She reads [in] the study. The children play [in] the living room. He takes a shower [in] the bathroom.

questions.text: How do you describe a room that has a lot of space?

content.content: {"time":1700000503000,"blocks":[{"id":"xY2zA3bC4d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Here is the key furniture vocabulary for the main rooms:"}},{"id":"eF5gH6iJ7k","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Living room:"}},{"id":"lM8nO9pQ0r","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["sofa / couch — диван","armchair — кресло","coffee table — журнальный столик","bookshelf — книжная полка","television / TV — телевизор","curtains — шторы","carpet / rug — ковёр"]}},{"id":"sT1uV2wX3y","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Bedroom:"}},{"id":"zA4bC5dE6f","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["bed — кровать","wardrobe / closet — шкаф для одежды","bedside table — тумбочка","mirror — зеркало","lamp — лампа","pillow — подушка","blanket — одеяло"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: There is a sofa in the living room.
My wardrobe is full of clothes.
I have a lamp on my bedside table.
phrases.translation: На тумбочке у меня стоит лампа.

content.text: In the living room there is a sofa and a coffee table. In the bedroom there is a bed and a wardrobe.

questions.text: Where would you typically find a 'coffee table'?

content.text: I put the food in the fridge. I boil water in the kettle. I wash my hands at the sink.

questions.text: What do you use to keep food cold?

content.content: {"time":1700000505000,"blocks":[{"id":"iJ9kL0mN1o","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Use these adjectives to describe your home:"}},{"id":"pQ2rS3tU4v","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Size: large, big, small, tiny, spacious"}},{"id":"wX5yZ6aB7c","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Condition: modern, old, new, comfortable, cosy, elegant"}},{"id":"dE8fG9hI0j","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Location: central, quiet, noisy, near the city centre, in the suburbs"}},{"id":"kL1mN2oP3q","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Type of home:"}},{"id":"rS4tU5vW6x","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["flat / apartment — квартира","house — дом","semi-detached house — дом на два хозяина","terraced house — дом в ряду","studio — студия"]}},{"id":"yZ7aB8cD9e","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example: I live in a small, cosy flat in the city centre. It has two bedrooms and a modern kitchen."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I live in a small cosy flat in the city centre. It has two bedrooms and a modern kitchen.

guessItems.hint: A very small flat with one room

content.text: I live in a [small] flat in the city [centre]. It has two [bedrooms] and a modern [kitchen]. The living room is [cosy] and bright. I really like my [home].

My bedroom is small but comfortable.

lessons.title: There is / There are — Describing Rooms

content.content: {"time":1700000506000,"blocks":[{"id":"fG0hI1jK2l","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"We use there is and there are to say what exists in a place:"}},{"id":"mN3oP4qR5s","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["There is + singular noun: There is a sofa in the living room.","There are + plural noun: There are two chairs in the kitchen.","There isn't + singular: There isn't a dishwasher.","There aren't + plural: There aren't any curtains."]}},{"id":"tU6vW7xY8z","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Questions:"}},{"id":"aB9cD0eF1g","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Is there a garden? — Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.","Are there any wardrobes? — Yes, there are. / No, there aren't."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: There is a sofa in the living room. There are two chairs in the kitchen. Is there a garden?

content.content: {"time":1700000507000,"blocks":[{"id":"hI2jK3lM4n","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Household chores are the jobs we do at home. Here are the most common ones:"}},{"id":"oP5qR6sT7u","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["clean the house — убирать дом","vacuum (the carpet) — пылесосить (ковёр)","mop the floor — мыть пол шваброй","do the washing / laundry — стирать","iron clothes — гладить одежду","wash the dishes — мыть посуду","cook a meal — готовить еду","take out the rubbish — выносить мусор","water the plants — поливать растения","make the bed — застелить кровать"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: I vacuum the carpet every week.

content.text: On Saturdays I vacuum the carpet and mop the floor. I always make the bed in the morning.

questions.text: What do you do when you 'take out the rubbish'?
options: You put rubbish in the bin outside

questions.text: Which chore do you do every morning?

content.content: {"time":1700000508000,"blocks":[{"id":"vW8xY9zA0b","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"We can talk about chores using these structures:"}},{"id":"cD1eF2gH3i","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Present Simple (habits):"}},{"id":"jK4lM5nO6p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I vacuum every Saturday.","She does the laundry on Sundays."]}},{"id":"qR7sT8uV9w","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Have to (obligation):"}},{"id":"xY0zA1bC2d","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I have to clean the bathroom today. — Мне нужно убрать ванную сегодня.","He has to take out the rubbish."]}},{"id":"eF3gH4iJ5k","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Sharing chores:"}},{"id":"lM6nO7pQ8r","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I do the cooking. My partner does the dishes.","We take turns vacuuming. — Мы пылесосим по очереди.","We share the household chores."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.content: {"time":1700000509000,"blocks":[{"id":"sT9uV0wX1y","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"When looking for a place to live, you need these words and phrases:"}},{"id":"zA2bC3dE4f","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Key vocabulary:"}},{"id":"gH5iJ6kL7m","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["rent — аренда / арендовать","landlord — домовладелец","tenant — арендатор","deposit — залог","furnished / unfurnished — меблированный / немеблированный","bills included — счета включены","available — свободен (доступен)"]}},{"id":"nO8pQ9rS0t","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Useful questions:"}},{"id":"uV1wX2yZ3a","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["How much is the rent per month? — Сколько стоит аренда в месяц?","Is it furnished? — Он меблированный?","Are bills included? — Счета включены?","When is it available? — Когда он свободен?","How many rooms are there? — Сколько комнат?"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: How much is the rent per month? Is the flat furnished? Are bills included?

guessItems.hint: The person who owns the property you rent
Money paid in advance as security
A flat with furniture already inside

content.text: A: How much is the [rent] per month? B: It's 800 dollars. [Bills] are included. A: Is the flat [furnished]? B: Yes, it has a sofa and a bed. A: Great! When is it [available]? B: From next Monday.

options: A flat that is very cheap
You pay extra for electricity and water
Electricity and water are part of the rent
Only the phone bill is included

It is quite spacious and modern. There is a balcony and the kitchen is very large. I really enjoy living there because it is quiet and comfortable."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}
